frozen.description: UltraBERT-150M (full FT, lr 2e-5, 3 epochs, bs 32, max_len 128, seed 1; early stopping/temperature on 400 held-out silver) trained on SOFT labels (per-level probability distributions) from deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash over the full SST-5 pool (7,924 train + 400 silver val). Labeling prompt: task spec + SST-convention guidance (experiments/sst5/guidance_v1.txt) + the 20 gold seeds as few-shot examples, distribution=True. Deployed as ONNX with partial dynamic int8 (all MatMuls quantised except MLP down_proj, attention-score MatMuls and the head, which stay fp32; full int8 collapses UltraBERT to 0.31 dev). Argmax decision, no bias calibration. Dev evidence (200 gold): labeler guidance v1 0.620 vs no-guidance 0.530 (deepseek-flash); UltraBERT students 0.600/0.615/0.610/0.610 (4 runs) vs gte-modernbert 0.54-0.585 (mean 0.56, 9 runs); deployed partial-int8 model dev acc 0.600, spearman 0.857.
